name: Montgomery County, NC
findings: Montgomery County has 54 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Montgomery County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Montgomery County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Montgomery County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.
